_README: White bars painted over number plates by tools/mask.mjs.
Boxes are [x, y, width, height] as FRACTIONS of the image, 0 to 1, from
the top-left corner. Fractions and not pixels on purpose: swap in a
higher-resolution original of the same shot and the numbers still hold.
nix develop -c node tools/mask.mjs --preview   check the aim
nix develop -c node tools/mask.mjs --apply     paint them in

re-derives from it — so a box can be corrected and re-applied without
